nodes.rationale: Read-only reviewer; legitimate direction changes should get an ADR rather than a rejection.

nodes.label: Claim labels [FACT]/[REC]/[POC]/[TRADE-OFF]
nodes.rationale: Every claim in an ADR must be evidence-labelled; vendor facts must be checked against current official docs, not memory.

nodes.label: RTX PRO 6000 vs L4 break-even (>=2.24x)
nodes.rationale: RTX PRO 6000 must be >=2.24x faster per output-second than L4 8/32 to be cheaper, derived from hourly rate ratio.

nodes.label: Layered CLAUDE.md context placement
nodes.rationale: Put durable rules in the most specific folder CLAUDE.md; root stays under ~25 lines; procedures become skills; one-offs go nowhere. Minimises loaded context per session.

nodes.label: No number without a log
nodes.rationale: Every benchmark value must link to a raw log or execution ID; estimates labelled ESTIMATE; failures reported as plainly as successes.

nodes.label: Load context on demand
nodes.rationale: Session starts with current-state.md only; other docs read when relevant to keep context small.
